gloss: to strive, to endeavor, to make an effort

definitions.gloss: to strive, to endeavor, to make an effort
definitions.explanation: To exert oneself toward a goal or to try one's best to do something. Typically used with ～ように努める or ～に努める patterns.

examples.japanese: {健康|けんこう}に{努|つと}める。
examples.english: I work to maintain my health.

examples.japanese: {早|はや}く{寝|ね}るように{努|つと}めている。
examples.english: I'm making an effort to go to bed early.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}の{解決|かいけつ}に{努|つと}めたが、なかなか{進|すす}まなかった。
examples.english: I strove to solve the problem, but it didn't make much progress.

notes:
Distinguished from the homophones {務|つと}める (to serve in a role/position) and {勤|つと}める (to work at a company). {努|つと}める specifically means making a conscious effort or striving toward something.

KEY PATTERNS:
・～に{努|つと}める — to work toward ~
・～ように{努|つと}める — to make an effort to ~
・{努|つと}めて (adverbial) — making an effort to; deliberately

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{改善|かいぜん}に{努|つと}める — to strive to improve
・{理解|りかい}に{努|つと}める — to try to understand
・{冷静|れいせい}でいるように{努|つと}める — to try to stay calm
・{節約|せつやく}に{努|つと}める — to try to economize
